summary: V2 Background Image Compliance Audit - Checkpoint D verification for Feature Gallery, Learning Hub, My Analytics, Settings, and Profile pages. Feature Gallery PASSED with transparent root and gallery variant. Learning Hub PASSED with coaching variant (transparent root in main content path). My Analytics, Settings, and Profile could not be fully verified due to session persistence issues during direct URL navigation - these pages redirect to welcome page when navigating via window.location.href. Sidebar navigation works correctly for Feature Gallery and Learning Hub.
